theorem: EXACT continuum lemma: around constant abelian background A^bkg_1=lam n, the O(lam) bilinear advection L(a)=g lam[n,d_1 a] satisfies ||L(a)||_2 = g|lam|(sum_i||d_1 a_i^perp||_2^2)^{1/2} (unbounded in lam at fixed a), while <a,[n,a]>=0 pointwise so L contributes nothing to d/dt||a||_2^2 through its color-rotation part.
